text:
Maya: Heads-up — PR #2314 (schema migration for orders service) is blocked by a flaky integration test `orders_integration.test_charge_retries`. CI keeps timing out on the integration-db job. Need a short rebase slot before the deploy blackout next Tue 22:00 UTC. Any availability?

Liam: on it :eyes: — can you paste the failing job log or the job id? I can try to reproduce locally quick.

Maya: job is `integration-db-05` in the CI run. Here’s the relevant snippet:
```
E   TimeoutError: DB connection timed out after 10s
-- > at tests/integration/test_charge_retries.py:42
     assert retry_count == 3
```
It passes sometimes but fails ~30% on CI.

ci-bot: CI run 2314.4: integration-db-05 failed (timeout). Rerun available.

Rajeev: I can carve out a rebase slot Thu 09:00-09:30 UTC if that helps. If the flake is infra (network), rerunning on a different worker may help first.

Sylvia: FYI we have the deploy blackout window Tue 22:00–Wed 04:00 UTC next week. If this isn't stabilised by Thu we should defer landing until after blackout unless it's a hotfix. Maintainers can force-merge with 2 approvals but avoid that if possible.

Liam: trying to reproduce now — running the single test with `pytest -k charge_retries -vv` against a local test DB. If it's a race, adding a small backoff or ensuring test DB is fully ready might be enough.

Maya: noted. I did a quick run on staging and saw a network hiccup on `staging-k8s-3` around the same time. Could be transient. I'm preparing a tiny WIP commit that increases the connection wait and adds a retry wrapper.

Liam: quick idea: try this locally, it reduces flakiness for me:
```python
# tests/integration/test_charge_retries.py
for _ in range(3):
    try:
        resp = client.charge(...)
        break
    except ConnectionError:
        time.sleep(0.5)
```
Not ideal but helps triage whether it's a transient network blip vs a real logic bug.

Maya: pushing WIP to `pr/2314-wip/retry-fix` now. Will trigger a CI rerun once it's up.

ci-bot: Rerun queued for PR #2314 (run 2314.5).

Rajeev: slot reserved Thu 09:00-09:30 UTC — @Maya please claim it if you want to land in that window. If you need a slightly later slot (09:30–10:00) say so.

Maya: claiming Thu 09:00–09:30 UTC. Thanks Rajeev :pray: I'll aim to have green CI by then. Plan: 1) push WIP fix and rerun CI, 2) if green, rebase and merge in reserved slot Thu ~09:15 UTC, 3) if still flaky, escalate for maintainer force-merge with 2 approvals or schedule for post-blackout.

Sylvia: sounds good. If you need reviewer eyes ping @SRE-team and @maintainers 10 minutes before the slot.

Liam: I’ll review immediately after the CI run. If the tests are still flaky we can try a targeted rerun on a different runner label (e.g., `runner: low-latency`) — Rajeev can help switch.

Maya: perfect — will update the PR with the CI links and ping here when the rerun finishes. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI run 2314.5 started.

Maya: (follow-up) CI run 2314.5 passed the integration-db job locally but one unrelated lint job failed — fixing now. Will rerun and keep slot.

Liam: good call. keep us posted.

Maya: updating plan in PR description with the reserved slot and merge checklist.

Rajeev: acknowledged. I'll hold the zone.

Sylvia: thanks — closing loop once merged. Good luck!
